# fw tui

> Reference of the fw tui command: Launch interactive Material 3 TUI. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/tui/

Launch interactive Material 3 TUI

## Usage

```bash
fw tui
```

## Aliases

`fw m3-tui` runs `fw tui`. `fw god` runs `fw tui`.

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
